original_frontmatter.name: 3d-metal-material
original_frontmatter.description: Build hyperrealistic PBR metal in Three.js: steel, brass, gold, copper and iron as true conductors (metalness 1, measured F0 tint, no albedo) with roughness-varied finishes (polished, brushed anisotropic, aged with patina and worn edges) lit by a dark HDR studio of real bright window cards prefiltered with PMREM. Use when metal looks like grey plastic, a dull blur, or a black hole; when blades, tools, rings, ingots, hardware or product metal need reflections with edges and structure; or when a finish needs scratches, streaks, fingerprints and bevels that catch light.
